en.headline: Private home prices fall 0.6 percent in October after two-month rise
en.dek: The Rating and Valuation Department index slipped to 319 points while the private rental index reached a fresh record high of 213.2.
body: Hong Kong's private residential price index fell 0.59 percent month on month to 319 points in October, ending two consecutive months of gains, provisional figures from the Rating and Valuation Department showed on Thursday. The index remains 8.17 percent higher than a year earlier and has risen 6.48 percent in the first ten months of the year.

Prices of small and medium-sized flats declined 0.62 percent, while those of units above 100 square metres dropped 0.31 percent. Within the smaller categories, flats under 40 square metres fell 0.53 percent, those between 40 and 69.9 square metres fell 0.7 percent, and those from 70 to 99.9 square metres fell 0.49 percent.

Private residential rents continued to climb. The rental index rose 0.47 percent month on month to 213.2, a new high, and is 6.65 percent higher than a year ago. Over the first ten months the rental index has increased 6.3 percent.

zh.headline: 差估署：10月私人住宅樓價指數按月跌0.6% 結束兩個月升勢
zh.dek: 指數報319點，按年仍升8.17%；租金指數升至213.2，續創歷史新高。
body: 差餤物業估價署周四公布臨時數字，10月全港私人住宅樓價指數按月下跌0.59%至319點，結束連續兩個月上升。指數按年仍高8.17%，今年首十個月累計上升6.48%。
中小型單位售價按月跌0.62%，面積超過100平方米的單位則跌0.31%。細分來看，40平方米以下單位跌0.53%，40至69.9平方米單位跌0.7%，70至99.9平方米單位跌0.49%。
私人住宅租金持續上升。租金指數按月升0.47%至213.2，再創歷史新高，按年升6.65%。首十個月租金指數累計上升6.3%。
